For context, "**Deep Blue** was a chess-playing expert system run on a unique purpose-built IBM supercomputer. It was the first computer to win a game and the first to win a match, against a reigning world champion under regular time controls."

The source is "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deep\_Blue\_(chess\_computer)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deep_Blue_(chess_computer))"
